baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوا and the emphatic predicate إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sensory encounter precipitates rather than resolves uncertainty. The group compares the visible referent with an expected destination and locates the mismatch in themselves: they must have strayed from the intended place or aim.

activation_trace.role: Sensory seeing supplies the encounter that immediately triggers the diagnosis.
Uttered speech externalizes the group's shared inference at the moment of seeing.
Deviation from path or aim supplies the first spatial and purposive sense of their predicate.

changed_reading.before: They see something and make a general confession of error.
changed_reading.after: Their sight generates an immediate route diagnosis: the seen object does not match expectation, so they infer that they themselves have missed the intended place or aim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same feminine referent is both seen in رَأَوْهَا and followed by the declaration لَضَالُّونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparent contradiction between seeing and losing dissolves if visibility and identity are separated. An appearance is present, but the sought thing's recognizable identity has disappeared or cannot be located within that appearance.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance allows the eye to register a surface without guaranteeing recognition of what it is.
Disappearance or absorption supplies loss at the level of the expected identity despite a visible remainder.
Failure to locate a sought thing turns their predicate into a recognition hypothesis about the object as well as themselves.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the referent confirms that they have found and recognized it.
changed_reading.after: They can see a remainder while failing to find the expected thing in it; the ayah stages visible presence and recognizable loss at once.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic first-person plural formula قَالُوا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group does more than report a location error. It converts a fresh perception into a shared proposition and then into a collective category, provisionally defining who 'we' are under the shock of the sight.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment turns the sight into an interpretation rather than leaving it as bare sensation.
Speech as held belief lets the plural utterance consolidate a common account of their condition.
Speech as definition sharpens the utterance into a temporary self-classification: 'we are the lost ones.'
Departure from aim supplies the category with spatial, practical, and potentially ethical range.

changed_reading.before: The quotation merely records what several people happened to say.
changed_reading.after: The emphatic plural utterance is an act of collective self-definition, though the exact kind of lostness remains open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence joins reciprocal seeing, assay, disclosure, and knowledge of who has strayed. In the focus ayah, the tested people themselves complete that sequence: their eyes encounter evidence and their mouths disclose a condition that had not yet been admitted.

activation_trace.role: The focus sight is the sensory event through which the concealed condition becomes diagnosable.
The focus predicate names deviation from the aim disclosed by the event.
Reciprocal eye-seeing establishes vision as a promised sorting event, not neutral observation.
Assaying a person or metal supplies the mechanism by which an encounter makes an inner condition manifest.
Disclosure to a knower frames the result of the assay as an uncovering rather than a newly created condition.
The earlier explicit straying from a path gives the focus self-description a surah-level axis of aim and guidance.

structural_cues: 68:5-7 places seeing before the question of testing and the knowledge of who strays; 68:26 reenacts that order inside the garden episode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, assay, disclosure, and straying; I infer that the focus sight makes the speakers reveal themselves. A live alternative is that 68:5-7 only frames the surah thematically and does not specify this local causal chain.

changed_reading.before: They discover that they have taken a wrong route.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent route diagnosis is also an involuntary disclosure under trial: the sight draws their own condition into speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The referent is introduced as a tree-covered garden and then subjected to a revealing trial, cutting, interrupted yield, and deprivation. Its coordinates can remain while the vegetal cover and productive continuity that made it recognizable are severed; 'we are lost' is therefore a reasonable first hypothesis before 'rather, we are deprived' identifies the cause.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance supplies the altered surface against which expected garden identity is tested.
Disappearance supplies the loss of the garden's recognizable form within the still-visible site.
Failure to locate an owned thing makes the initial utterance a concrete hypothesis about the missing estate.
A test that makes a condition appear supplies the episode's transformation-and-revelation frame.
A garden hidden or enclosed by trees identifies vegetal covering as part of the referent's recognizable form.
Cutting and separation supply the physical break between the expected garden and the surface they encounter.
Interrupted milk or rain supplies a material image of productive flow abruptly stopping.
Failure to obtain the sought benefit supplies the speakers' explicit correction from mislocation to deprivation.

structural_cues: 68:17-27 moves from intended cutting, through an overnight transformation and a cut-like morning appearance, to sight, lostness, and then the corrective بَلْ naming deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure by vegetation, severance, interrupted yield, and deprivation; I infer that these changes erase recognizable garden identity while leaving something visible. A live alternative is a straightforward wrong-road mistake followed by recognition of the damaged garden.

changed_reading.before: They simply arrive at the wrong garden.
changed_reading.after: They arrive at the right site but initially cannot find their garden in its severed appearance; visible land and lost productive identity coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The planned boundary was social: prevent the poor person from entering and withhold the good. The reversal places the planners outside effective access to their own benefit, so their lostness can name a role exchange in which would-be owners become dispossessed outsiders.

activation_trace.role: Loss of an owned or located thing makes possession itself unstable at the focus moment.
The ownerless stray in a place of loss supplies an exploratory image for owners rendered without effective ownership.
Withholding the hand from giving establishes the social logic that the garden owners enact.
Entry into an interior supplies the access boundary they intend to police.
Abasement through poverty identifies the person whom the planned boundary is designed to exclude.
Withholding and contraction turn their morning purpose into an active barrier rather than mere harvesting.
Deprivation reverses the withheld benefit onto the speakers themselves.
Holding someone back from a right clarifies the injustice that drives the reversal.

structural_cues: 68:24 denies entry and benefit to a poor person; 68:27 makes the speakers deprived; 68:29 lets them recognize the wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, an entry barrier, poverty, deprivation, and withheld right; I infer a reciprocal reversal that moves the planners to the outside of effective ownership. A live alternative is punishment without a precise exchange of social positions.

changed_reading.before: 'We are lost' reports a navigation mistake affecting otherwise secure owners.
changed_reading.after: 'We are lost' also registers a social-topological reversal: those who meant to exclude another find themselves outside the benefit and identity of ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: An oath, omitted exception, productive asset, fixed intent, and calculated capability compose a tight control model. The visible result falsifies that model in one stroke; their first speech is an abductive repair, assigning the mismatch to their own route before they can admit that control over the harvest has failed.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment converts the anomalous visual evidence into an explanatory hypothesis.
Saying with the force of supposing marks the utterance as a provisional inference rather than a settled gloss.
Deviation from intended aim supplies the first repair to the failed prediction.
A binding oath supplies confidence that the intended action will occur.
Excluding an item from a total supplies the omitted contingency that makes their plan closed to revision.
Accumulated work and gain identify the garden as the productive asset their model assumes is available.
Directed intent supplies the plan's fixed target.
Measured planning and estimation supply their claim to predictive control.

structural_cues: The episode accumulates commitment and control language before the focus ayah, while 68:27 immediately replaces the speakers' first explanation with a harsher one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, no exception, productive work, intent, and calculated planning; I infer that 'we are lost' is the first hypothesis used to preserve that control model under anomalous evidence. A live alternative is an unmediated literal route error.

changed_reading.before: The speakers calmly recognize a known fact about being off course.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is a rapid model-saving hypothesis: if the expected garden is absent, they first blame their route rather than surrender their claim of control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group moves from assembly and lowered plotting speech to a visible shock, a provisional diagnosis, correction to deprivation, a central member's countervoice, confession, mutual blame, and admission of transgression. The focus quotation is therefore one update in a distributed reasoning process, not the narrator's final disambiguation of ضالون.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance marks the point where the group's hidden coordination becomes audible diagnosis.
Suppositional saying keeps the focus statement available for correction by the next utterance.
The group's meeting or assembly supplies the collective channel in which its successive judgments form.
Lowered secret speech supplies the concealed discourse that precedes the focus ayah's exposed declaration.
Deprivation supplies the explicit next-stage correction to the lostness hypothesis.
The just or best middle voice introduces an internal critic who reorders the group's account.
Putting a thing outside its proper time or place converts spatial mismatch into acknowledged wrongdoing.
Mutual blame shows the collective diagnosis fragmenting into assignments of responsibility.
Transgressing the limit supplies the later moral specification that the focus predicate itself leaves open.

structural_cues: Speech changes register and diagnosis across 68:21, 68:23, 68:26-31; the corrective بَلْ in 68:27 prevents the first quotation from functioning as a final gloss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of secret, collective, corrective, critical, confessional, and accusatory speech; I infer that the focus line is an intermediate abductive update. A live alternative is that each utterance is an independent exclamation rather than a shared reasoning trajectory.

changed_reading.before: 'We are lost' is the episode's settled explanation and moral verdict.
changed_reading.after: It is the first public update after shock, preserved as spatial, practical, and ethical ambiguity until later speech progressively specifies deprivation and transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden is lexically a place covered by trees, while later cues oppose hiddenness to lifted covering and exposed open ground. On this axis the disaster does not merely damage an object; it removes the cover that made the place count visually as the object they sought, so seeing the site produces loss of category.

activation_trace.role: Visible aspect makes category recognition depend on what the surface still displays.
Disappearance supplies the paradoxical loss of garden identity within a site that remains before the eyes.
The tree-covered garden makes covering constitutive of the referent rather than incidental decoration.
Lifting a cover supplies the surah's later grammar of forced exposure.
Being screened from eyes establishes hiddenness as the complementary pole of the visible-loss mechanism.
Open uncovered ground supplies the endpoint of a place stripped of the sheltering features that identify it.

structural_cues: The feminine object seen in 68:26 is introduced as the garden in 68:17; later ayat repeatedly stage uncovering, hiddenness, and exposure in open ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies garden-as-tree-cover, removal of covering, hiddenness, and exposed ground; I infer that loss of cover causes loss of visual category at 68:26. A live alternative is that these later exposure cues belong to separate scenes and only analogically illuminate the garden.

changed_reading.before: They fail to recognize a badly damaged but otherwise stable object.
changed_reading.after: They see a site whose defining cover has been removed, so the garden disappears as a category before it disappears as a location.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, gaze is paired with making someone slip from a station. Read back into the focus causal hinge, sight does not stabilize the observer's position: their own looking at the transformed object makes their positional certainty slide, and the seers rather than only the seen object become 'lost.'

activation_trace.role: The focus act of seeing is grammatically adjacent to the speakers' sudden loss of orientation.
Departure from path or aim supplies the positional state into which their certainty slips.
Slipping a thing from its station on a surface without foothold supplies the destabilizing motion assigned to gaze.
Eye-seeing pairs the dislodgement image with gaze rather than with ordinary travel.

structural_cues: Both 68:26 and 68:51 place a visual act next to loss of stable position, but reverse who is threatened with dislocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later gaze-plus-slippage pairing; I infer a reversed, self-directed analogue in which the garden owners' gaze dislodges their own orientation. A live alternative is thematic resonance without a causal echo.

changed_reading.before: Seeing locates the observers while only the object is uncertain.
changed_reading.after: The sight itself dislocates the seers: the transformed object deprives them of cognitive and positional foothold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary speech root. It remains anchored in قَالُوا immediately after visual shock and gains support from the later dislodgement image; downstream prose should render it only as a somatic or acoustic undertone, not as an etymological replacement for 'they said.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا stands between the sudden sight and the emphatic plural diagnosis.

activation_trace.role: A shudder from fear or anger lets the spoken diagnosis carry the body's immediate shock.
Rattling and unstable motion give the plural utterance an acoustic texture of shaken certainty.
Loss of aim keeps the bodily activation attached to the actual predicate rather than becoming free imagery.
Dislodgement from a stable station gives context support to the utterance's exploratory instability.

changed_reading.before: The speakers deliver a composed proposition after inspection.
changed_reading.after: Their proposition may also be heard as a collective shudder: language and bodily destabilization arrive together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ء ي to ر و ي mapping. It remains materially anchored in رَأَوْهَا, the cultivated referent, the lost-object predicate, and the cue of interrupted rain or yield; downstream prose should qualify it as a hydrological resonance in what their eyes assess, never as the lexical meaning of رَأَوْهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَأَوْهَا makes the garden's visible material condition the evidence for لَضَالُّونَ.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst supply the absent saturation against which a cultivated place can be visually judged.
A remaining residue sharpens the possibility that they see only what is left after productive fullness has vanished.
Failure to locate the sought thing anchors the material resonance in their explicit loss judgment.
Interruption of milk or rain supplies the context's concrete break in nourishing flow.

changed_reading.before: They assess only whether the land is the correct location.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory material layer, their eyes assess whether any water-fed fertility remains, and lostness names a garden reduced to residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it connects the opening pen-and-line images to the cut garden. It remains anchored in the focus act of reading a visible appearance, the branch in which a thing 'says' by indicating, the disappearance predicate, and the episode's cutting; downstream prose should call it a compositional analogy of legibility and erasure, not claim that the garden is literally writing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers inspect a visible surface and verbalize what that surface seems to indicate.

activation_trace.role: The pared writing implement supplies the opening image of a surface made legible through inscription.
A cut section of land bridges writing's tool to the garden's materially divided surface.
An ordered written line supplies the expected readable pattern against which disorder is registered.
A line of striking or cutting lets inscription and severance coexist in the same contextual image.
Cutting and separation supply the event that effaces the garden's expected visual pattern.
Visible appearance anchors the analogy in the surface the speakers actually inspect.
A thing's 'saying' as indication makes their speech a voiced reading of what the transformed surface signifies.
Disappearance supplies the erasure of the familiar pattern without requiring the ground itself to vanish.

changed_reading.before: They look at damaged land and fail to identify it.
changed_reading.after: The transformed landscape behaves like an erased or overwritten surface: they voice a failed reading when its expected pattern no longer signifies 'our garden.'

strongest_changes: The focus declaration becomes a provisional abductive hypothesis produced by anomalous sight, not a final gloss on ضالون.
The cutting and deprivation sequence allows the correct site to remain visible while the garden's productive and recognizable identity is lost.
The planned exclusion rebounds, making would-be owners experience the outside position and deprivation they assigned to the poor.
The surrounding speech sequence preserves several successive readings: mislocation, deprivation, wrongdoing, blame, and transgression.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah makes sight cause lostness rather than cure it. That hinge sustained coexisting spatial, perceptual, social, epistemic, and ethical readings, while split-root branches preserved contained somatic and material resonances that a conservative synthesis would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: At the instant of 68:26, spatial mislocation, failure of recognition, and dawning ethical self-diagnosis remain genuinely coactive.
The later cover, exposure, and gaze-slippage cues may be deliberate reactivations of the garden scene or only strong intra-surah analogies.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل and ر ء ي to ر و ي activations are packet-authorized but non-dominant and must remain exploratory rather than lexical claims.
